name: sqlc-ts
description: Typed TypeScript query functions from sqlc's JSON analysis

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && for d in postgres sqlite mysql; do cp src/dialects/$d/runtime.ts dist/dialects/$d/; done
scripts.fixture: export SQLC_PATH="${SQLC_PATH:-$PWD/.sqlc/bin/sqlc}"; for d in postgres sqlite mysql; do (cd test/fixture/$d && node ../../../src/cli.ts generate codegen_request.json gen) || exit 1; done
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Publish through the Release workflow (pnpm release): it adds the sqlc platform packages.' && exit 1
scripts.release: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm pack:all && node scripts/sqlc-packages.ts publish .pack
